question: I'm a CS sophomore who just finished 15-122 with a B. Can I register for 15-213 (Introduction to Computer Systems)?
expected_answer: Yes — 15-213 requires 15-122 at least C. A B exceeds that threshold, so P-003 is eligible to register. No co-requisites for 15-213.
common_mistake: Overlooking that the minimum grade for 15-122 → 15-213 is C, not B; assuming any pass is sufficient
needs_verification: Confirm P-003 completed 15-122 with exactly a B (not a D or lower)
Confirm 15-213 has no co-requisites in the current catalog
Confirm P-003's transcript shows 15-122 completed (not in-progress)
